semantics.SHARED_DEFINITION: Copy approved neutral schema, headings and component structure only; scrub media, content references, provider IDs and URLs
semantics.TENANT_SOURCE: Provision from new company's authoritative source; may be blank on demo if no verified value
semantics.TENANT_MEDIA: Use destination company-owned media and media-source provenance; never reuse an originating company photo gallery or local attachment ID
semantics.RECONNECT_PROVIDER: Disconnect original account and require new-company account consent, credentials and verified ownership
semantics.NO_CROSS_TENANT_COPY: No customers, submissions, orders, bookings, payment tokens, credentials, events, grants, runtime audits or person-specific data
semantics.SANDBOX_ONLY: Test fixtures belong only in isolated test database
semantics.REBUILD: Regenerate caches, CSS artifacts, job state and indexes for destination
semantics.REMAP_GEO: Copy global geography semantics only; map site/language-specific term IDs and treat term media as tenant-owned
semantics.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Stop cloning this source until independently classified

provision_group_policy.source: Elementor template and JetEngine listing/template definitions
provision_group_policy.caveat: Only structural widget/query/filter definitions; embedded layout JSON must be scrubbed/rebound to destination media, pages, people, links, colors and forms

provision_group_policy.source: JetEngine destinations, location_jet, tour_type, trans_mode, trans_type taxonomies
provision_group_policy.caveat: Term hierarchy reusable when globally neutral; WPML translation families and IDs per site; logo/featured_image excluded
Can reuse independently licensed generic copy after source review; company products, itineraries, prices, media and promotion remain tenant-owned
Prices, availability, suppliers, allotments, currencies, discounts, origin/destination conditions per company; never clone another company's commercial rows

provision_group_policy.source: WooCommerce products, stock, payment methods, orders and payment tokens
provision_group_policy.caveat: Install product type and rate schemas, but generate target-company product/rate records with source proof; do not clone transactions

provision_group_policy.source: Fluent Forms form definitions and multilingual layouts
provision_group_policy.caveat: Do not inherit form notification recipients, endpoints, submission history or company-specific form mappings

provision_group_policy.source: Fluent Forms submissions, CRM, support tickets and e-mail delivery logs
provision_group_policy.caveat: Personal and company operational records are not template data

provision_group_policy.source: Tenant users, roles, capabilities, WordPress application passwords
provision_group_policy.caveat: Provision fresh owner and scoped role grants; never copy users or authority tokens

provision_group_policy.source: MAD4B company grants, site UUID, control-plane site profile, audit and outbox
provision_group_policy.caveat: Provision site UUID and authority from trusted enrollment; preserve audit of source but don't replay to target

provision_group_policy.source: WPML translated strings, post/term family IDs
provision_group_policy.caveat: EN source may anchor neutral template text; target language families created only from verified translation mapping, not raw IDs
Share only Elementor widget/layout; review image collection, media source, content ratings, profile identities and third-party provider bindings are TENANT_MEDIA/TENANT_SOURCE
No published QA fixture in staging/Production tenant clone; existing 93 quarantined to Draft on Staging

provision_group_policy.source: WordPress cache, LiteSpeed runtime cache, Elementor page assets, transients and runtime jobs
provision_group_policy.caveat: Provider account connections are RECONNECT_PROVIDER and do not survive reset

external_provider_bindings.provider: Rank Math SEO Google / Search Console
Google Drive OAuth and AI providers

required_preflight: New target site_uuid, database, site origin and owner independently enrolled
Full source inventory/digest and zero unclassified selected fields
Every company-specific and media value sourced from approved new company
Public site name, logos, colors, support/contact and SEO Organization validated
Provider accounts disconnected by default; all credentials, API secrets, provider IDs and tokens must be newly issued for the target company and individually rebound with explicit consent
Canonical media catalog IDs resolved to new attachment ownership and checked for licensing
Translation EN origin preserved with per-language target term/post ID remapping
No QA fixtures or cross-tenant leaked strings in published HTML, cards, Schema or media
All provider outbound tasks disabled until owner-governed activation
Dry-run, rollback, before/after snapshots and readback on target; no Production mutations
taxonomy_term_note: Six observed destination term meta keys explicitly reviewed; hashed lat/lng cache-style keys remain REVIEW_REQUIRED until normalized stable geo resolver is certified. WPML term IDs must be remapped.

jetengine_options_requirements.field_definitions: 11 registered JetEngine pages, 180 active fields, 64 nested repeater child fields; exact source manifest gates
jetengine_options_requirements.unregistered_stored_values_rule: BLOCK_REVIEW: stored-only legacy keys are not company-owned configuration source; do not clone, do not auto-delete from existing site
jetengine_options_requirements.demo_placeholder_rule: Only for Wo Vacation demo; normal companies must supply their own brand/marketing/media and contact values, or leave disabled/blank
jetengine_options_requirements.company_scope_rule: JetEngine native get_option is site-global; a single-site multi-company deployment cannot reuse these values across company_ids without a strict per-company resolver and separate persistence
jetengine_options_requirements.runtime_effect: reviewed contract only, not enforced on existing WordPress settings save
